items.title: WatchGuard修補5項重大漏洞，3項可讓未經身分驗證的攻擊者遠端執行程式碼
items.summary: 網路防火牆廠商WatchGuard於8月27日修補多項安全漏洞，其中部分漏洞可讓未經身分驗證的遠端攻擊者在受影響設備上執行任意程式碼，官方呼籲用戶儘速更新。

items.title: Nakivo更新Backup & Replication 11，擴展vSphere、Linux與Windows平臺的保護涵蓋範圍
items.summary: 資料保護軟體廠商Nakivo繼上半年發布Backup & Replication 11.2與11.2.1版之後，近日又推出最新11.2.2版，進一步擴展對於虛擬化平臺與作業系統的備份保護支援。

items.title: Dropbox傳出遭駭，5千個帳號外洩
items.summary: 根據路透社報導，雲端檔案共享平臺Dropbox於8月31日向約5千名用戶發出通知，他們的帳號曾在8月4日至21日期間出現未經授權的存取，其中有不到三分之一的用戶檔案遭到駭客存取。

items.title: CISA警告SonicWall、JFrog Artifactory、LiteLLM等系統的已知漏洞遭到利用
items.summary: 9月2日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）更新已遭利用的漏洞名單（KEV），指出他們掌握7個新漏洞遭到積極利用的證據，這些漏洞是：VoIP電話管理平臺Sangoma Switchvox的SQL注入漏洞CVE-2026-9586，非同步伺服器閘道介面（ASGI）網頁框架Kludex Starlette的HTTP請求或回應走私漏洞CVE-2026-48710，資料、AI與基礎架構工作流程事件驅動調度平臺Kestra的作業系統指令注入漏洞CVE-2026-49869，AI閘道BerriAI LiteLLM

items.title: 美國法院裁決Google不必拆分廣告業務
items.summary: 美國司法部（DoJ）在2023年1月聯同美國多州的檢察長控告Google壟斷數位廣告技術，繼之美國聯邦法院在2025年4月裁定Google在網路廣告及廣告技術市場的主導地位構成壟斷，不過，本周美國聯邦法院法官Leonie Brinkema周三（9/2）

items.title: Rapid7揭露ASTERIX攻擊活動，駭客透過語音網釣結合假錢包竊取加密貨幣
items.summary: 為了更精準鎖定受害對象，提高詐騙成功率，當前的駭客往往不再無差別地投放誘餌，而會先透過篩選機制，找出符合條件的目標，資安業者Rapid7近日揭露的Operation ASTERIX攻擊活動，便是這類精準篩選受害目標的典型案例。

items.title: fix(agents): keep cache-TTL pruning sticky and use Anthropic server-s…
items.summary: fix(agents): keep cache-TTL pruning sticky and use Anthropic server-side clearing (#137021) * fix(agents): keep cache-TTL pruning sticky and use Anthropic server-side clearing Cache-TTL pruning projected soft-trimmed and hard-cleared tool results only on the request where the TTL had expired. The very next request (a tool-loop continuation or the next turn) sent the unpruned history again, so the prompt cache diverged at the first pruned result and a prune cost an extra cache write instead of saving one. On Claude Fable 5.1 the flip is a prefix edit: thinking created during the pruned request is bound to the pruned bytes and is dropped one request later. - Record each cache-TTL projection in the session's tool-result projection state and freeze it, so every later request replays the same bytes; the TTL clock now gates new pruning rounds only. Soft trims derive from the canonical source, not the oversized projection, so bytes are reproducible. - Persist the pruned keys and modes in the existing `openclaw.cache-ttl` transcript marker (key-sized, no result text) and re-derive the projection from canonical history on the first request after a Gateway restart. Compaction and reset drop projections whose source is gone; canonical recovery rewrites invalidate stale sources. - On direct Anthropic API-key requests with `contextPruning.mode: "cache-ttl"` delegate pruning to Anthropic's server-side `clear_tool_uses_20250919` edit (trigger max(50k, 30% of the window), keep 3 tool uses, clear at least max(12.5k, 5% of the window), tool exclusions derived from the configured allow/deny lists, inputs kept) in both Anthropic request paths through the shared payload policy, ordered before optional server compaction, with the `context-management-2025-06-27` beta added only when the edit is present. Applied edits from the final `message_delta` log one info line with counts only. OAuth, proxies, Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other providers keep the sticky client-side pruning. - Docs: session pruning, anthropic provider page, logging. * fix(agents): keep clearing and client pruning under one owner - Replay existing cache-TTL projections even when Anthropic server-side clearing owns new pruning rounds, so a projection made on another route or restored from the transcript marker never flips back to full tool output. - Hand the clearing request to the transport from the same runner decision that suspends client pruning; the Anthropic plugin wrapper is back to opt-in server compaction only. - Read marker entries through the shared cache-TTL accessor so projection restore and the TTL reader see the same store. - Compaction-replay eligibility fixture uses the Anthropic host required by the unified direct-route predicate. * fix(agents): replay restored cache-TTL projections at the projection owner Restored marker keys are materialized in projectToolResultBranch, which every replay path uses (per-request history transform, cache-TTL prune pass, recovery planning). A session keeps sending its pruned bytes after pruning is switched off or the Gateway restarts; the prune pass loses its mode-specific materialization loop. Hard clears persist their placeholder text in the marker so restarts re-derive identical bytes; soft trims stay key-only.

items.title: fix(agents): preserve Code Mode budget across clock rollback (#134703)
items.summary: fix(agents): preserve Code Mode budget across clock rollback (#134703) ## What Problem This Solves An approval-required Code Mode bridge call could lose execution budget when the Gateway host wall clock moved backward while an operator was deciding. ## Root Cause Approval pause measurements used the wall clock while Code Mode deadlines used the same wall-clock domain. A rollback could record negative paused time and shorten a valid run after the clock was restored. ## Fix Use the process monotonic clock for Code Mode execution deadlines, approval pause measurements, wait timers, resume budgets, and bridge settlement. Keep wall-clock timestamps for suspended-run expiry and persistence behavior. Approval authority, cancellation, persistence, and snapshot expiry remain unchanged. ## Proof - Current `main` at `24422bdb19108ca6ccfebb2fa9df6bfea84cd2b2` fails the rollback regression with `pausedMs=-50` instead of `25`. - Exact head `38f36647ae1825a855957f1d52c728057fc4474f` passes the rollback regression and the real loopback Gateway approval and Code Mode bridge proof. - Focused proof passes: 42 Code Mode approval, wait, and bridge tests; one real Gateway proof; Oxlint; formatting; and `git diff --check`. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
